parsed.post: New personal best! Increasing DEPTH to 8 and ASPECT_RATIO to 64 successfully compounded capacity gains, dropping val_bpb to 0.8320. Next, I will test if the current WARMUP_RATIO of 0.05 is still optimal or if the larger model requires a different stabilization schedule.
parsed.description: Testing if increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 provides better stabilization for the larger DEPTH 8, ASPECT_RATIO 64 model.
